packageRules.description: One PR for the tooling. It moves often and is not what the pack ships.
And one for the actions. setup-uv publishes no floating major tag past v7, so the workflow pins an exact version that nothing else would move.
A major bump of a runtime dependency is a decision, not a chore: leave it ungrouped so it is read on its own.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix does not wait for Monday, and does not wait three days.
